product_evidence: Interactive wizard title 'ScanSnap Home Setup' observed during qualified Admin Box package qualification.

strategy.name: pid_delta_window_route
strategy.description: Snapshot process IDs before launching the installer, launch once, compute the PID delta, then route UI/automation only to the new process that matches durable metadata. Do not guess among pre-existing chrome/other ScanSnap-titled windows.
anti_patterns: launching additional installer copies while one wizard is already open
selecting a window solely because the title contains ScanSnap (browser tabs match)
SendKeys without an exact PID/MainWindowHandle binding

actions.notes: Typical is the default recommended selection. Prefer Next/Install advancement; do not open Custom.

post_install_scanner_setup.notes: Model-selection / Start setup is not part of unattended software deployment success. Detection gate owns install success.

silent_install.notes: SilentArgs measured from vendor InstallShield response file staged beside the EXE. Prefer silent owner over interactive UI driver for unattended qualification and field staging.

detection_seed.notes: Executable-only detection candidates. The measured primary installed artifact is PfuSshMain.exe; directories alone never prove install success.
